title: Keto Ground Turkey Broccoli Casserole: Low Carb Recipe Guide

macro_cross_check.verdict: PASS on the protein instrument, but barely, and called out loudly: -14.3% sits just inside the 15% tolerance. The main protein is anchored by an explicit source weight (1 lb ground turkey), so no each-weight assumption exists to be wrong; every other line is a printed volume measure converted at densities figures. The source's own macro set is internally inconsistent with its ingredient list: 1 cup heavy cream across 4 servings is 59.5 g/serving = 19.8 g fat from cream alone, plus 9.1 (cheddar) + 8.1 (turkey) + 6.75 (oil) = 44 g fat, yet the page prints 30 g total fat while its 18 g SATURATED fat matches our build almost exactly (cream ~14 sat + cheddar ~5 sat) - their 'unsaturated 12g' line is the undercount, and 4x9 on the missing ~14 g fat is precisely the 130-cal calorie gap. Their 35 g protein would need ~1.25 lb of turkey; the page prints 1 lb. Conclusion: the source calculator's totals are off, our portions match the source's printed measures line for line, and the gap points at their fat arithmetic rather than any portion of ours.
macro_cross_check.carb_note: Our 13.1 g is gross carbs from label/USDA rows; the source's 8 g gross / 6 g net with only 2 g fiber undercounts the broccoli (75 g fresh broccoli alone is 5 g gross, 2 g fiber) plus cream 4 g and onion 2.5 g. Still far under the 35 g gate either way.
macro_cross_check.band_check: computed 580.9 cal in [400, 650] PASS (headroom 69 cal to the ceiling); carbs 13.1 g <= 35 PASS. Sensitivity: if 'large head' really means ~400 g of florets instead of the densities 300 g, the serving moves +8.5 cal / +0.7 P / +1.7 C - the band holds under either reading.

board_defects_observed: ingredient-map.json's only broccoli entry (item 'Broccoli Florets' -> board_id 'frozen-broccoli-florets') points at an id that is not a commodity id in commodities.json (the frozen commodity's id is 'frozen-broccoli'); the fresh commodity 'broccoli' has no map entry at all. This mapping carries bid 'broccoli' in the mapped file so the scaler-bid fallback books it; a map entry (Broccoli -> broccoli, weekly) and a correction of the frozen row's id are flagged for the map's owner, not edited here.

Term-vs-map split on cheddar persists (recorded by earlier batches): bare term 'shredded cheddar cheese' answers via generic shredded-cheese whose Walmart cell is a Kraft boxed mac-and-cheese dinner, while the recipe-board id cheddar-cheese-shredded is the correctly-classed product.
densities_followups: Broccoli: densities carries head=300 / cup=85 only under 'Broccoli Florets'; propose a 'Broccoli' alias row (head 300, cup 85) so the fresh item name resolves, and consider a 'large' key (~400) since recipe sources routinely size broccoli heads.
